# ankra_alert_ingest_credential (Resource)

An alert ingest credential (`ankra alerts ingest-credentials`): the endpoint and token an external notifier, such as Prometheus Alertmanager, delivers alerts into Ankra with. The platform returns the token only when it mints it, so `token` is set at create and kept in state (marked sensitive), and is null after an import. Pinning to a cluster and the scope change in place; a change of `name` or `enabled` mints a new credential. Destroy revokes the credential, so its token stops delivering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_alert_ingest_credential" "alertmanager" {
  name       = "prod-alertmanager"
  cluster_id = ankra_cluster.prod.id
  scope      = "mixed"
}

output "alertmanager_webhook_path" {
  value = ankra_alert_ingest_credential.alertmanager.webhook_path
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Credential name. Changing it replaces the credential.

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster the credential is pinned to. A `mixed` credential must be pinned; a `platform` one must not be. Unset unpins it.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the credential accepts deliveries. Defaults to `true`. Changing it replaces the credential.
- `scope` (String) `cluster`, `platform` or `mixed`: which alerts the credential may deliver.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the credential.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token the notifier sends. Revealed only when minted; null after an import.
- `webhook_path` (String) Path, under the platform's address, that accepts Alertmanager webhook payloads for this credential.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by credential id. The token cannot be read back.
terraform import ankra_alert_ingest_credential.alertmanager 2a3b4c5d-6e7f-4809-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b
```
